strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal_5m_2m

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for price to briefly break or wick beyond the level and then reclaim/fail it
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to briefly break or wick beyond the pre-market level and then reclaim or fail it; trade the opposite direction of the failed break.
entry_sequence.rationale: A liquidity sweep is a brief fakeout above or below the level followed by a reclaim.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: after the retest of the level, after the breakout of the level, or after the liquidity sweep of the level
entry_sequence.action: Enter after the liquidity sweep/reclaim confirmation at the level.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker says entries come after confirmation of the level interaction.

stop.transcript_quote: The stop is always going to go on the opposite side of the entry candle.
stop.rationale: "The stop is always going to go on the opposite side of the entry candle."

strategies.stop_management: Move the stop to breakeven or into profit as the trade moves in your favor, then let it run until stopped out or satisfied with profits.

targets.transcript_quote: bare minimum of 1x of my original risk
targets.rationale: "I'm typically looking for bare minimum of 1x of my original risk."

targets.transcript_quote: ideally what I'm looking for is a 1.5x to a 2x my original risk
targets.rationale: "ideally what I'm looking for is a 1.5x to a 2x my original risk."

confluences.transcript_quote: after 3:00 a.m. Eastern time all the way up into New York market open
confluences.name: pre_market_window
